title: Father's Silver Tone Orchestra and its members
summary: The father led the Silver Tone Orchestra; Dutre tries to recall its sidemen, including a banjo player, trumpeter and bassist Babe Phillips.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

Do you remember any other people he worked with?
